design.readout: deterministic nearest-centroid (no optimizer -> no lr/starvation confound)
design.control: per-sample block permutation of the same wave family

why_no_claim: pre-registered G-I-LAW required monotone non-increasing in ingredient count AND raw(513)<=0.70 AND raw(48)>=0.80. The endpoints pass (0.5146<=0.70, 0.8857>=0.80) but monotonicity FAILS: sorted ascending by ingredients, raw = 48:0.8857, 72:0.9287, 258:0.7529, 513:0.5146. The 48-vs-72 pair inverts. Conjunctive gate -> no claim.

RESOLVES_THE_ORIGINAL_CONTRADICTION.now_explained: the discriminating variable is the number of distinct ATOMIC INGREDIENTS, not manifold cardinality. Reproduced in one controlled sweep at fixed manifold size.

INGREDIENT_EFFECT_IS_REAL.statement: with the manifold HELD at 512 and the readout rule HELD fixed, raw accuracy moves 0.5146 -> 0.9287 as atomic ingredients move 513 -> 72. Span 0.4141.
INGREDIENT_EFFECT_IS_REAL.the_inversion: the 48-vs-72 pair inverts (0.8857 < 0.9287). Held-out n=1024, SE_diff ~= 0.0128, so the gap is ~3.4 SE. A REAL inversion, not sampling noise. My monotone formalization does not predict it.
INGREDIENT_EFFECT_IS_REAL.interpretation_LABELLED_NOT_A_FINDING: both 48 and 72 sit in the near-ceiling regime (0.886, 0.929), so ordering inside that regime is compressed and may be governed by a different term than total ingredient count. This is a reading, not a measured mechanism.

CROSS_CHECK_WITH_V_SWEEP.note: consistent direction across both corpus families

BLUEPRINT_RELATION.supported: sec 2.4 item 3, typed decision manifolds -- now with a measured lever. Typed decomposition makes the atomic vocabulary SMALL BY CONSTRUCTION, and small atomic vocabularies sit near ceiling. At (32 tools x 16 args) the heads score 0.9502 (32-way) and 0.9951 (16-way) vs 0.8857 for the flat joint on the SAME corpus.
BLUEPRINT_RELATION.rejected: the causal autopsy. The bottleneck was encode() hash-filling 8096/8192 rows (HASH_FILL_IS_THE_SNR_DEFECT), upstream of the readout.
BLUEPRINT_RELATION.untested: the Hopfield Lexical Snap. beta is argmax-invariant; beta*=26.10 remains externally asserted, unverified on host.

class: large controlled effect with a refused claim: endpoints satisfy the pre-registered gate, monotonicity does not
